name: 174-seq-every-construct-loads
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key type string -
key lat float deg
key lon float deg
key callsign string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key label string -
key qty int -
key x int -
key y int -
key a float -
list items "a list"
list subs "a nested list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.8.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
field probe.qty 8 uint
bit_order msb
const 4 10
pad 4
align 8
default probe.x 1
presence p 2
if p.1
  field probe.x 8 uint
end
if !p.2
  field probe.y 8 twos
end
presence f fx
if f.9 p.2
  field probe.label 16 ascii trim
end
opt
  field probe.a 16 sscale:1/4 swap
end
chain
  field probe.x 7 uint
  fx
  field probe.y 7 uint
  fx
end
length 8 bits plus -2
  field probe.y 8 uint via t
end
length 16 whole plus 1
group probe.items count 8
  field probe.x 8 uint
  group probe.subs while
    field probe.y 8 uint
  end
end
map t 1 2
